ad_library.summary: Orbit Solar is the longest continuously-running advertiser in this batch: five live ads, the oldest started 6 November 2025 - residential ('They trusted us. You can too', 10 Dec 2025, six creatives), two commercial/industrial ROI ads (6 Nov 2025), an industrial Telangana ad (14 May 2026) and a new On-Grid Solar + UPS combo (4 Sep 2026). Every ad funnels to fb.me or WhatsApp - none points at a specific page on orbitsolar.in. The site itself (fetched 2026-10-22) claims MNRE-approved vendor status, carries residential and commercial brochures, a savings calculator and an enquiry form, and lists a Mehdipatnam address - none of which the ad copy uses beyond printing 'orbitsolar.in'.

funnel.destination: fb.me 'Sign Up' / 'Get quote' on the residential and UPS-combo ads; WhatsApp (wa.me/919059806772) on the commercial and industrial ads
funnel.meaning: No ad sends its click to a page on orbitsolar.in. The commercial and industrial spend - the highest-ticket offers - lands in a WhatsApp chat, and the residential spend lands behind an fb.me wrapper. The site's calculator, brochures and enquiry form sit outside the paid path entirely.

findings: Five live ads and the oldest has run since 6 November 2025 - a year of continuous spend across residential, commercial and industrial angles, plus a new On-Grid + UPS combo (4 Sep 2026).
Not one ad points at a page on orbitsolar.in - residential and UPS-combo ads go to fb.me, the commercial and industrial ads go straight to WhatsApp.

The install-count claims differ across live ads: '1000+ installations across Hyderabad' (residential), '500+ Successful Installations Across Telangana' (commercial) and '1,000+ industrial clients across India' (industrial) - a prospect who sees two ads sees two different companies.
No email address is published anywhere on the live site - enquiries only via the form (name, mobile, email, location, monthly bill), phone or WhatsApp.
The newest offer - On-Grid Solar + UPS Combo with smart auto-switching - has no page of its own on orbitsolar.in; the ad is the only place it exists.
next_steps: Give each angle its own owned page

Residential, commercial/industrial and the new UPS combo are three different buyers. One landing page per angle on orbitsolar.in - each with its own form - turns a year of fb.me and WhatsApp spend into a funnel you own and can test.
1000+ installations, 500+ across Telangana and 1,000+ industrial clients cannot all be the headline. One verified number, used everywhere, is worth more than three that contradict.
A business spending on Meta for a year with no email on its site loses every enquiry that prefers to write. A care@ address on the form, the footer and the ads.
On-grid + UPS with auto-switching is a differentiated product with a live ad behind it - it deserves a page with the combo, the switching logic and the net-metering assistance explained.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
